title: Retained action data reaches the next mission stage without operator copying
problem: Signed strategies cannot currently consume successful prior-action output automatically.
founder_intent_refs: Founder full-machine directive supplied in this 2026-10-07 session
baseline: Existing mission actions and receipts are durable, but strategy parameters remain static.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Resolve bounded typed $from_action data against successful same-mission receipts before the existing Gate. Record receipt, event and value digest. Keep capability, target and scope literal. Expose pipeline.inspect through the existing registry and appraisal owner.
advantages: Uses existing mission, registry, Kernel and ledger owners.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Fresh executable compatibility and outcome evidence.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Integrate latest #145 changes immediately as a second broad merge.
advantages: Retains its additional budget, routing and native repertoire mechanisms.
disadvantages: Unreviewed overlapping contracts would obscure attribution and introduce another conflict set.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Fresh executable compatibility and outcome evidence.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Keep the convergence on a draft branch and challenge it through signed local missions.
advantages: Preserves main and founder deployment decisions.
disadvantages: Test identities and local outcomes do not prove live founder use.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Fresh executable compatibility and outcome evidence.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Mind and Hands remain disconnected; operators still transfer results.

evidence.finding: Signed test-key missions and separate-process appraisal; no production or economic claim.

counterevidence.finding: False: latest #145, generic CLI confinement, actual browser/provider chains, founder-device and external economic/human proofs remain open.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack authority drift, false proof, provider dependence, complexity, stale source inventory, cross-mission leakage and hidden labor.

new_weaknesses.statement: A new pipeline runner would duplicate mission scheduling.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Implement resolution inside existing observe/pursue and appraisal contexts.

new_weaknesses.statement: Receipt existence alone might admit another mission output.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require matching successful mission action and positive receipt; mutation removes this check and must fail.

new_weaknesses.statement: Malformed type objects and non-JSON output could cause uncontrolled exceptions.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Validate string type tags and translate JSON failures to bounded binding errors.
